item.name: Read the derived, non-authoritative ConcernGroup organisation of one BodyState revision.

request.name: Read the derived, non-authoritative ConcernGroup organisation of one BodyState revision.

description.content: Computed on read, never stored. Hypothesis–fact, hypothesis–observation and episode–fact links form an undirected graph; every connected component containing at least one hypothesis or episode is one group. Group id (DC-032, rule concern-group-anchor-v2): UUIDv5 of the group's anchor, the anchor-eligible member (current hypothesis lineage or current episode; never a fact or observation) whose lineage began earliest. Stable across linking/unlinking/correcting/withdrawing facts and observations, correcting any hypothesis, recording newer hypotheses, merges (earlier anchor wins) and splits (the part keeping the anchor keeps the id); it changes only when the anchor lineage leaves the group. Still a derived display id: never a foreign key or a clinical conclusion.

response.name: Deterministically ordered derived groups for current_revision.
